project_title: Graph-Guided Repository Navigation for Coding Agents
limitations: The evaluation uses one Python repository.
The evaluation contains only 12 manually reviewed queries.
The results are exploratory and cannot establish general superiority.
Automated dataset validation does not independently prove semantic correctness of every query-target pair.
No statistical significance claim will be made from this small evaluation.
warning: Exploratory evaluation on one repository and twelve manually reviewed queries. Results do not establish general superiority.
